name: Magician
summary: Magician is a unlicensed port of the Commodore 64 game Magic Madness, remade by original developer Colosoftware in 2000. The game would be first released on the Famiclone plug-and-play system GameStar AL-27605M by Macro Winners Electronics along with several other Colosoftware ports and would later appear on many other bootleg famicom multicarts.
